about: How people at home say what happened to a relative, in talk, from the health engine's records (Words builder W1, Nov 12, 2026). A cause of death is said only where people say it plainly to family; the rest are told by the age at death alone. An illness is said by its common name. Read by src/director/conversation.ts (relativeNews). Words only; no sentence. A stroke is told without its name, since "It's a stroke" is not how people say it. A case's offense is said from the defendant's own side: taking bribes, paying a bribe or offering one (bribe-taken, bribe-paid, bribe-offered). An official is said as someone outside government says them: by the body they sit on or the office they hold alone (Words builder S3, Nov 14, 2026).

youngBelowAge.checkedAgainst: A death below this age is spoken of as early ('only 52'); U.S. life expectancy at birth was 77.5 in 2022 (CDC NCHS, Mortality in the United States, 2022), and a death more than about fifteen years short of it is the one people call too young.
